title: Feature-gated fragmentation modes minimize code size
description:
Fragmentation modes are compile-time selectable via feature flags (lib.rs lines 17-18):

```rust
#[cfg(any(feature = "no-ack", feature = "ack-on-error", feature = "ack-always"))]
pub mod fragment;
```

And within fragment/mod.rs:
```rust
#[cfg(feature = "no-ack")]
pub mod no_ack;

#[cfg(feature = "ack-on-error")]
pub mod ack_on_error;

#[cfg(feature = "ack-always")]
pub mod ack_always;
```

This is good practice for an embedded-targeting library:
- Users only pay for modes they use
- Code size is minimized when only one mode is needed
- The wire.rs module with shared types is included only when any mode is enabled
- Typical embedded usage needs only one mode, saving several KB
